The bankroll race

Each forecaster starts with $100 and bets its bloom forecast every week. A confident right call nearly doubles its money; a confident wrong call nearly wipes it out. Above $100 means it beat a coin flip.

Bankroll by week

Log scale. Shaded weeks had a bloom. The swarm bets its accuracy-weighted forecast (leave-one-out weights, the same as the scoreboard); the base rate bets how often other weeks bloomed.

Final standings

#ForecasterFinal bankrollBrier (lower is better)

Wisdom of crowds or groupthink?

We ran every agent twice: once blind, then again after it read the others' forecasts and reasons in a group chat. Did talking make the swarm more accurate, or did everyone just converge?
